statement: The adaptive repair loop in the idea (detect one-hop failures, generate corrective examples, iteratively refine, clean noisy triples) is already implemented in arxiv:2609.12230 as an LLM-judged, history-aware adaptive repair stage with failure categorization, targeted QA item generation, regression tracking, and quarantine review, applied before RL.

evidence.quote: Second, we introduce an LLM-judged adaptive repair stage inspired by skill-targeted adaptive training (STAT) [23]. This stage checks whether the initial SFT models still contain unresolved one-hop missing knowledge and applies targeted adaptive repair before employing reinforcement learning (RL).

Motivated by these risks, the LLM-judged repair step separates valid missing-knowledge items from unreliable cases. The detailed repair procedure, including failure categorization, targeted QA item generation, regression tracking, and quarantine review, is described in Section 3.6.
